name: zzbd_manager_create_temp_read_stream_from_buffer
description: zZbdManager::CreateTempReadStreamFromBuffer creates a CRT temp FILE, writes the supplied buffer, flushes it, rewinds it, and returns the stream ready for reads.
binary_ninja_evidence: 0x4c0780 calls tmpfile, writes the buffer with fwrite(buffer, size, 1, tmpStream), then calls fflush and rewind before returning the FILE pointer.
The this pointer is present in ECX but is not read; arguments are the buffer and size stack parameters.
known_limits: code/function tier S byte verification is deferred to a coherent zUtil ZBD temp-stream source-cluster pass.
